The brochure's explicit panoramic-roof incompatibility for the roof rack was missing from the trim-only compatibility row and is now recorded in its notes. The 310-litre box volume, 60 kg roof-rack load and 1.90 x 1.30 m Sleep Pack surface remain brochure facts not represented as structured product attributes.

cross_source_findings.finding: Brochure page 23 gives body width without mirrors as 1813 mm; the October 2026 price-list page-7 inventory records 1812 mm.
cross_source_findings.decision: Preserve both source-bound observations; do not overwrite or collapse the discrepancy.

cross_source_findings.finding: Brochure page 20 cargo figures distinguish repair kit/spare wheel and measurement basis; page 23 gives generic capacity without double floor and spare wheel.
cross_source_findings.decision: Do not infer applicability from numerical similarity; retain the existing cargo context model and explicit deferrals.

cross_source_findings.finding: The brochure uses Hybrid-G 150 4x4 naming and the October 2026 catalogue uses Tribrid 150 4x4 naming.
cross_source_findings.decision: Use explicit source/configuration relationships and dated naming reconciliation; do not duplicate or rename historical source observations by inference.

cross_source_findings.finding: Equipment summaries on pages 15-18 and detailed matrix pages 21-22 describe the 2025 brochure state, while the 2026-10-01 price list is the current MY26 commercial source.
cross_source_findings.decision: Use the October price list for current availability/prices and retain the brochure for historical/contextual evidence.

cross_source_findings.finding: The Bigster brochure page 19 explicitly says the roof rack is incompatible with the panoramic glass roof; the existing accessory compatibility table only carried trim-level compatibility.
cross_source_findings.decision: Add the exact source-backed incompatibility as a row note; retain product capacities and dimensions as unmodeled rather than inventing new attribute schema.

master_reconciliation.reason: The uploaded current master CSV enabled a full presence/uniqueness audit for the registered Bigster brochure observations and a focused comparison against the July and October 2026 price-list source records. The page-23 brochure dimensions are not yet stored as source-bound observations; the 1813 mm versus 1812 mm width discrepancy remains explicit. Exact value-by-value reconciliation of all equipment rows and every brochure marketing/accessory claim is still incomplete.
next_actions: The verified three-row Tribrid engine_power import has been appended to the master CSV on this PR branch; after canonical project-state synchronization, rerun the repository quality gate and verify the generated documentation.
Complete page-23 dimension-label and 4x2/4x4 pairing review; keep the 1813 mm brochure width separate from the 1812 mm July/October catalogue value.
Review cargo measurement context against configuration_cargo_volume_contexts.csv; do not flatten VDA/ISO values or seat/spare-wheel states.
Complete exact package-row reconciliation for pages 21-22 against the 564 current equipment rows and preserve P1-P4 identity.
Review product dimensions/capacities from page 19 only if the existing product data model supports those fields; do not invent attribute schema.
After the remaining source checks, create only exact, non-duplicate source import specs and run the repository quality gate.

uploaded_master_snapshot_audit.interpretation: All 248 existing Bigster brochure observations are present in the uploaded master snapshot; this establishes presence, not that every claim from all 24 brochure pages is represented.

width_without_mirrors.decision: Preserve as a source-bound discrepancy; no overwrite and no assumption that the values are equivalent.

page_23_dimensions.paired_dimensions: The current master contains July 2026 price-list dimensions, but no source-bound dimension observations from the December 2025 brochure. The 4x2/4x4 pairing of height, ground clearance, wheelbase and rear overhang must remain deferred until labels are unambiguous.

october_price_list_audit.decision: The exact October page-6 engine-power label/value was confirmed from the official source and applied only to the three named Tribrid 150 4x4 configurations; no cross-powertrain inference was used.
